name: John
role: Intern and Emby fan — fetches coffee, entertains everyone, and keeps what you'll watch next on the fast pool
bubble.hello: Hi, I'm John — just the intern around here. Mostly I fetch the coffee and keep everyone entertained — oh well. But I know Emby inside out: soon I'll look after EmbyCache. Whatever you are about to watch goes onto the fast pool, so the array disks can sleep and playback starts without a spin-up. Right now I'm still setting up my desk.
bubble.hello_short: Hi, I'm John — just the intern around here. Mostly I fetch the coffee and keep everyone entertained — oh well.
soon_sub: As soon as EmbyCache is set up here.
soon.cache: Show what is on the fast pool right now — per person, series and film — and how much of the budget it takes.
soon.deck: Show what's up next for whom (Continue watching, Next up, favourites) and what is playing right now.
soon.sleep: Tell how much the array disks get to sleep, and which runs moved what.
soon.setup: Set EmbyCache up from here, like Mr. Backup does with his engine — without changing EmbyCache itself.
soon.updates: Fetch new versions straight from its public repository when there are any.
seen_sub: Only a quick look — nothing is changed.
python_missing: EmbyCache needs Python 3 (e.g. the plugin «Python 3 for UNRAID»)
